title: Predicting Lymph Node Metastasis Status from Primary Muscle-Invasive Bladder Cancer Histology Slides Using Deep Learning: A Retrospective Multicenter Study.
summary: Publisher full text read in Chrome: attention-based weakly supervised MIL on H&E slides predicted lymph-node metastasis in muscle-invasive bladder cancer; 323 TCGA patients for training and independent external cohorts of RHWU n=139 and PHHC n=78, with external AUCs .762 and .746. Retrospective diagnostic/prognostic association; external performance is moderate and not a replacement for node pathology.
